project: Engenharia Reversa / original REA MCP on Linux VPS
title: Live investigation Evidence and Unknown records are empty after controlled Ghidra session close

probable_root_cause.behavior: closeActive defaults clearRecords=true and calls clearSessionRecords() after provider retirement; this can erase in-memory InvestigationRecords and Unknowns. The bridge executes close_binary after a successful open_binary even when the source-owned fixture is temporary.
probable_root_cause.behavior2: clearSessionRecords invokes InvestigationRecords.clear() and resets analysis snapshots.
probable_root_cause.causality: Strong code-and-timing-supported hypothesis; prior 8-record state was not independently read immediately before the Ghidra fixture in this turn.
